label: Missing value
definition: A required field is blank for a record.

label: Missing field
definition: A required field is absent from the file.

label: Unexplained gap in a series
definition: A time or area series has a missing period or area with no explanation.

label: Duplicate record
definition: The same thing is recorded more than once.

label: Reference not unique
definition: Two or more records share an identifier that should be unique.

label: Invalid data type
definition: A value cannot be read as its declared type (number, date, flag, URI).
mhclg_equivalent: invalid integer / invalid decimal / invalid date / invalid flag / invalid URI

label: Value does not match pattern
definition: A value does not follow its required format, for example a code pattern.

label: Invalid category value
definition: A value is not in the agreed list of allowed values.

label: Invalid geometry
definition: A shape or coordinate cannot be processed.

label: Value out of range
definition: A number is smaller or larger than its allowed range.

label: Date in the future
definition: A date that cannot be in the future is in the future.

label: Implausible date
definition: A date is too far in the past or future to be credible.

label: Location out of bounds
definition: Coordinates fall outside the expected area.
mhclg_equivalent: WGS84 out of bounds of England

label: Fields disagree
definition: Two fields in the same record contradict each other.

label: Parts do not add up
definition: Parts do not sum to the stated total, or shares exceed 100%.

label: Reference not found
definition: A value refers to something that does not exist in its reference list.

label: Data out of date
definition: The latest period in the data is older than the update frequency allows.

label: Late publication
definition: A release arrived after its scheduled date.

label: Measure not described
definition: A column has no unit, measure definition or reference period, so values can be misread.

label: Protected characteristic not recorded
definition: A field for a protected characteristic or need is blank.

label: Protected characteristic defaulted or unknown
definition: A protected characteristic holds a default, 'unknown' or 'not stated' value.

label: Quality differs between groups
definition: A quality measure is materially worse for one group of people than for others.

label: Population undercoverage
definition: Some people or places the data should describe are missing.

label: No named data owner
definition: The asset does not name an accountable owner organisation or role.

label: No data quality action plan or equivalent
definition: No DQAP, quality statement or methodology is published or linked.

label: Metadata review overdue
definition: The record has not been reviewed in the last 12 months.

label: Update frequency not stated
definition: Users cannot tell how often the data is refreshed.

label: Time period not stated
definition: The period the data covers is not stated (temporalCoverage).

label: Geography not stated
definition: The places the data covers are not stated.

label: Creation date not stated
definition: The dateCreated property is not recorded.

label: Version information missing
definition: The expires and supersededBy properties are not recorded.

label: Schema or standard not declared
definition: The conformsTo property is not recorded, so structure cannot be checked.

label: Security classification not stated
definition: The securityClassification property is not recorded.

label: Licence not stated for the asset
definition: Only a site-wide licence applies; the asset's own licence is not stated.

label: Access rights unclear
definition: It is not clear whether access is open, charged or restricted.

label: Link has no named publisher
definition: A data link does not say who publishes it.

label: No machine-readable format
definition: Data is only offered as PDF, web pages or dashboards.

label: No API
definition: No programmatic access is offered.

label: Methodology not linked
definition: No methodology or quality information is linked.
source: Code of Practice for Statistics / QAAD

label: Quality caveats not stated
definition: Known limitations are not described.

label: Error on the page
definition: The page contains a factual error, for example a wrong organisation name.

label: Breakdowns by people not stated
definition: For data about people, the page does not say which groups can be compared.

label: UK nations not signposted
definition: Data covers part of the UK and does not point users to the other nations.

label: Invalid identifier
definition: An identifier fails its format or check-digit rule, so records may not link to the right person, place or organisation.
